description: Defra annual supply balances shown as national context for the five Food Origins baskets (Stage 5, LP-05; John, 25 Oct 2026). Values are read as published; the build checks that total supply = production + imports - exports and that the share = production / total supply. Never combined with HMRC monthly trade (spec SS-07).
